Nina (Partnerships): Heads-up  Orbita signed the SOW. They want a compact "SI Onboarding Sprint" so their engineers can deliver a joint PoC and go-live on marketplace in four weeks. Who can lead the sprint artifacts?
Aj (GTM): Ill own the partner checklist + launch comms. Need a co-branded sell sheet and a short demo runbook (50 mins).
Devon (Solutions): Ill author the demo runbook and a skinny PoC template. I need staging creds and which model/prompt bundle to use.
Eli (Training): I can build a short self-serve badge (15 questions) + a ~25m recorded walk-through. Prefer self-serve badge initially. :white_check_mark:
Nina (Partnerships): Self-serve works. Please include two quick labs: 1) Redwood hosted demo; 2) simple local deploy (docker).
Sam (Eng): Staging model endpoint for demo: `https://staging-orbita.redwood.ai/models/demo-v3`. Ill create access for Orbita engineers; opening ticket now.
Zoe (Marketing): Will start the co-branded one-pager. @Nina can you share Orbita logo + one-sentence partner quote? :memo: 
Aj (GTM): Orbita asked for marketplace guidance (AWS/GCP). Eng, what does the canonical package look like and how do we expect metering to be called?
Sam (Eng): Marketplace integration checklist: signed partner manifest, packaging tarball with `model.tar.gz` + `manifest.yaml`, and a billing webhook. Test payload we use: 
```
POST https://billing-staging.redwood.ai/events
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "partner": "orbita",
  "units": 120,
  "resource": "inference_tokens"
}
```
Send me the contract contact and Ill scope auth.
Devon (Solutions): PoC prompt mini-pack (draft): 1) concise summarization; 2) multi-turn chat with follow-ups; 3) embeddings search score. Ill put finalized prompts into `partners/orbita/prompt-pack.md`.
Eli (Training): Draft agenda for partner workshop (remote, 60m): 10m intro; 25m hands-on lab (staging); 15m debugging patterns; 10m badge quiz. Badge auto-issues on passing.
Nina (Partnerships): Proposed sprint timeline: Week 0: kickoff + access; Week 1: training + co-branded assets; Week 2: run PoC; Week 3: QA, marketplace packaging; Week 4: listing + joint announce. Any objections?
Aj (GTM): Fine if Eng can deliver staging by Friday EOD. Also want a PR and asset bundling plan by end of Week 3.
Sam (Eng): Ill prioritize the staging env and upload a marketplace manifest template. ETA Fri EOD. Kicking off env creation: tagging @deploy-bot now.
deploy-bot: env-create initiated: workspace=orbita-staging, requested-by=@Sam, status=pending
Zoe (Marketing): For announcement, recommend a short technical note + partner quote and a cross-post on marketplace listing. Ill draft a template and share by Tuesday.
Devon (Solutions): Suggest adding a tiny eval harness to catch regressions during the PoC. Ill check it into `partners/orbita/evals/ci.yml`.
Eli (Training): One ask for Partnerships: please send three SI role descriptions (implementation engineer, solution architect, sales engineer) so the badge scenarios map correctly.
Nina (Partnerships): Will DM the role bullets and Orbita contact list. Scheduling 30m kickoff with Orbita tomorrow 11am PT and sending invite shortly.
Aj (GTM): Recap of owners: Aj = checklist + PR plan; Devon = runbook + eval harness; Sam = staging + manifest; Eli = training + badge; Zoe = co-brand assets + announcement. Anything blocking from legal or contracts?
Nina (Partnerships): Contract sign-off is complete. Legal flagged standard marketplace indemnity clause but not blocking. Add any blockers here. :thumbsup:
